requirement: Ask Tracy prepares the new session and sends a native user brief before provision

oracle.invariant: An accepted action waits for its real server-created chat, then opens once. Leaving the screen or cancelling an in-flight read prevents navigation. Another action, old workflow or unsafe destination never opens. Retry preserves the conversation and bulk opens one accepted demo. New client-send actions prepare an exact session before installing CMS and submit through the native composer. Reload, uncertainty and two tabs reuse the winning native request ID; no backend prompt is sent. The queued demo can reopen its existing chat without creating another build.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
